title: mission.mission_resolved
description: Emitted exactly once at the terminal transition of the mission state machine. parent_event_id chains back to the event that caused the resolution (last failed/completed objective, player death, timer expiry, or player abort).

loss_reason.description: Stable replay vocabulary from LossReason::as_str(). Never a raw string literal.

loss_objective_id.description: When loss_reason is `objective_failed`, the objective id that triggered the loss.

show_me_why_event_id.description: Lost outcomes attach the cause-chain root event id so the M10 replay viewer's 'Show Me Why' button can jump directly to it.
